findings.note: NHL.com's projected lineup has Lundell on the right wing of a third line with Lars Eller and Eetu Luostarinen, not the top six. Barkov and Marchand are listed as injured, and Byram is out for Chicago.

Florida has allowed nine straight goals, with a 5-1 loss at Ottawa and a 4-0 loss at Pittsburgh. Chicago is 3-7 and allowing 4.00 goals per game, and Forsling is day-to-day after taking a puck to the face.

The Panthers' preview says Florida swept Chicago last season and is 7-3 in the last 10 meetings. Chicago will start Knight (.888 save percentage) or Soderblom (.820), and the preview has no Lundell-specific note.
